Auditor's sub-claim that (i), (v), (vi) and (4.25) are never restated for v.profiles is overstated. Lean restates the analytic rectangle, exterior pressure, zero exterior mass and both reserved patches for the modified profile.

The edge identities n(X_a) ∥ (a,−b_s) and n(X_b) = (1,0) are stated by no declaration about the modulated stress. The collar lemmas hide the coefficient behind ∃ G and export only positivity and ε-margins.
